title: 第29章 返乡
content_zh:
第29章 返乡-《我发现了世界BUG》

存书签

下一章

此时无论是林舒还是厉雨都还不知道，他们已经进入了警方的视线，成为了重点调查对象。

换完钱后的林舒回到了家里，忙着研究徐长顺留下的文档、忙着在公群里旁观各路大佬发言、忙着想辄调甲方出来。

而厉雨则是下了火车又转汽车，整整近20个小时的车程后，终于回到了他从小长大的熟悉的古顺县。

三个月之前，自己第一次离开县城，见到了更大的世界。

那时候自己本来以为，靠着一身本事，自己可以在外面闯出一片天来。

----别说我手艺老，我手艺是老，可那也是真东西啊！

刷刷短视频看看，用AI搞算命擦边直播、一点真才实学都没有的人一个月都能捞个几万块，难道自己还赚不到一笔足够让自己脱身的钱？

别说几百上千万，搞个几十万，找个偏远的地方一躲，再发展点会员啊、私域啊之类的捞钱，一辈子也就这么过去了。

至于什么失传的蛊术、什么消失的昆尸，那都跟自己没关系了。

天远地远的，你就算真成煞了，把这破县城杀得血流成河，跟我有有啥关系呢？

可惜，理想很丰满。

而现实......

那真他妈是烂透了。

短视频都是骗人的，离开县城一个月，自己愣是一毛钱都没赚到。

直到那个时候自己才醒悟过来，原来那些在网上付钱算命的人要的根本不是真才实学，人家要的是情绪价值。

而自己是完全不擅长提供情绪价值的。

走投无路之下，自己也是动用了最后的底牌，不惜冒风险去接脏活。

一开始自己确实是赚了点钱的，可刚刚接到了一笔大单子，一根闷棍就迎头砸下了......

林舒......

那个年轻人。

雇主给的资料里说，他就是一个普普通通的小记者，只是因为采访内容触动到了某些人的利益，才想让他平静地消失。

这个说辞其实很可信，毕竟大部分信息都是对得上的。

可万万没想到，这居然会是那么硬的一个茬子。

蛇......

厉雨打了个冷战。

他警惕地环顾四周，确认没有看到蛇的踪迹，才稍稍放下心来。

那小子实在是太邪性了.....

他怎么会是普通人？！

你告诉我一个普通人会法术？

一个普通人会的法术，能在自己面前具象出一条蛇来？

一个普通人会的法术，能隔着几百上千公里给我咬了？

真是草了你祖宗了......难怪价格开那么高，合着是要命的买卖啊？！

这跟让我拿把土铳去干掉全副武装的特种兵有什么区别？

更可怕的是，拿土铳去干特种兵，至少人家的武器都是看得见的、都是挂在身上的，小心谨慎一点，搞不好还有胜算。

At this time, neither Lin Shu nor Li Yu knew that they had come into the police's sight and became the focus of investigation.

After exchanging the money, Lin Shu returned home and was busy studying the documents left by Xu Changshun, busy watching the speeches of various bosses in the public group, and busy trying to transfer Party A to come out.

Li Yu, on the other hand, got off the train and then transferred to the car. After nearly 20 hours of driving, he finally returned to the familiar Gushun County where he grew up.

Three months ago, I left the county for the first time and saw the bigger world.

At that time, I originally thought that with my skills, I could make a name for myself outside.

----Don't say my craftsmanship is old, my craftsmanship is old, but it is also the real thing!

Check out the short videos. People who use AI to do fortune telling and live broadcast without any real knowledge can make tens of thousands of dollars a month. Is it possible that I still can’t make enough money to get out?

Don't talk about hundreds of millions, get hundreds of thousands, find a remote place to hide, and then develop some memberships, private domains, etc. to make money, and your whole life will go by like this.

As for the lost Gu skills and the disappeared corpses, it has nothing to do with him.

You are so far away, even if you are really evil and you have killed this poor county to a river of blood, what does it have to do with me?

Unfortunately, the ideal is very full.

And reality...

That fucking sucks.

The short videos are all lies. After leaving the county for a month, I didn’t make a dime.

It wasn't until that time that I realized that what those people who paid for fortune telling online didn't want real knowledge at all, they wanted emotional value.

And I am completely bad at providing emotional value.

In desperation, he also used his last trump card and took risks to take on the dirty work.

I did make some money at first, but as soon as I received a big order, a sap hit me head on...

Lin Shu......

That young man.

The information given by his employer stated that he was just an ordinary young reporter who wanted him to disappear peacefully just because the content of the interview touched the interests of certain people.

This argument is actually very credible, after all, most of the information is correct.

But I never expected that this would be such a tough one.

Snake…

Li Yu shuddered.

He looked around vigilantly and made sure he saw no trace of the snake before feeling relieved.

That kid is really evil...

How could he be an ordinary person?!

Are you telling me that an ordinary person can do magic?

Can an ordinary person use a spell to materialize a snake in front of him?

Can a spell that an ordinary person can bite me from hundreds or thousands of kilometers away?

You are really insulting your ancestors... No wonder the price is so high, co-authoring is a deadly business, isn't it?!

What's the difference between this and asking me to use a blunderbuss to kill heavily armed special forces?

What's even more frightening is that if you use muskets to fight special forces, at least the weapons are visible and hung on your body. If you be careful, you might still have a chance of winning.
